description: Camera grammar for mok-tua storyboard panels. Ported/inspired by StoryboardUI2 (144 angles) + dx8152 multi-angle natural language + lovis93 Next Scene prefix.

camera_phrases.slow push-in from medium-wide: Move the camera slightly forward from a medium-wide shot toward the subject.
camera_phrases.static medium close-up: Turn the camera to a medium close-up, eye-level, static frame.
camera_phrases.slow orbit right: Rotate the camera 30 degrees to the right while keeping the subject centered.
camera_phrases.top-down: Turn the camera to a top-down view.
camera_phrases.wide establishing: Turn the camera to a wide-angle lens, establishing shot.
camera_phrases.close-up: Turn the camera to a close-up.
camera_phrases.dolly out: Move the camera back / pull back.
camera_phrases.low angle: Low-angle eye-level shot looking up at the subject.
camera_phrases.high angle: High-angle shot looking down at the subject.

presets.natural: Turn the camera to a wide-angle lens, front eye-level establishing shot.
Medium shot, eye-level, subject facing camera.
Turn the camera to a close-up, eye-level.
Front-right quarter view, eye-level medium shot.
